summary: You build retrieve(): embed the question, search the store, filter by kind. You migrate the chunks table with two metadata columns, ingest again, compare filtered and unfiltered searches, and make an unknown kind fail loudly.
goal: Add a metadata filter to a search.

items.text: Replace store.py, add pipeline.py, run ingest.py and match the 26 chunks by kind
Run search_filtered.py and predict how each filter changes the list
Ask for the kind errors and read the error, then see what happens without the check
Allow a search over two kinds at once
Write the filter tests and commit
Play the Filter the Search game to the end and see your score
